content.answer: When updating a single-select field's options, always merge by stable id: keep each existing option's original object (its old id) untouched if the name is unchanged, assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names continuing from max(existing id)+1 — never rebuild the option list from names alone, because that regenerates every id and silently clears the value references in all existing rows.
content.reuse_advice: For any id-referenced catalog update (single/multi-select, statuses, tags): read the current options first, diff by id (not name), pass through unchanged items with their original ids, append only truly new items with ids continuing from max(existing id)+1, and never reconstruct the list from labels alone — rebuilding ids by name silently breaks every existing row reference.
